title: Prismm Platform Aims to Help Banks Retain Inherited Funds
excerpt: Prismm introduces a tool allowing account holders to grant pre-access to family members, helping financial institutions retain inherited assets.
body_html:
A new platform named Prismm is designed to help financial institutions keep inherited funds within their networks. The service allows account holders to provide designated family members with early access to their accounts and relevant documents ahead of time.

By enabling account holders to organize and share access to their financial information with loved ones proactively, the system addresses the common challenge banks face when inherited wealth is transferred to external institutions.
